chunks: And crystal clear bottles of silver, of which they will determine the measure themselves.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'crystal clear bottles of silver' in Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'glass' (qawarir) is often interpreted as a unique creation, distinct from earthly glass, symbolizing absolute purity and transparency of the heart. The phrase 'they determined its measuring' (qaddaruhu taqdeeran) is understood by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai to refer to the precise, effortless estimation of volume by the inhabitants, reflecting their heightened spiritual awareness and the removal of any burden in enjoyment. This highlights the transition from the struggle of worldly measurement to the effortless abundance of the hereafter.
